intent.proves: No page on a language layer points at a master page that is missing or deleted.
intent.scope: pages on non-deleted language-layer websites; complete enumeration

bindings.reason: Tool is scoped to one area or page; a handler must enumerate every area/page and aggregate, which mcp-count does not do.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 CAST(p.PageId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' -> ' + CAST(p.PageMasterPageId AS nvarchar(20)) FROM Page p JOIN Area a ON a.AreaId = p.PageAreaId WHERE ISNULL(a.AreaMasterAreaId, 0) > 0 AND a.AreaDeleted = 0 AND p.PageDeleted = 0 AND ISNULL(p.PageMasterPageId, 0) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Page m WHERE m.PageId = p.PageMasterPageId AND m.PageDeleted = 0)
